# Pestr

> Professional pest control for hotels, restaurants, and commercial kitchens in India — full chemical disclosure, FSSAI/HACCP-ready documentation, and a written 30-day guarantee.

Pestr is a hospitality-focused pest management service. Every visit is documented, every chemical disclosed with a Safety Data Sheet, and every property gets a quarterly audit dossier formatted for FSSAI and HACCP. Contact via WhatsApp at +91 9648116960.
